localFindings.description: Route-end validation takes the LAST non-zero entry of path[11] anywhere in the array, but Curve Router NG stops at the first hop whose next pool slot (path[i*2+1]) is zero and pays out path[i*2] to the receiver. A path with an interior gap (e.g. [token, pool0, X, 0, ..., USDC]) passes validation yet the router delivers X, not the reward token. Consequence: X is not sold, surplus = balance - owed underflows, and every harvest reverts until the owner fixes the route (fail-loud DoS, no fund loss since the tx reverts). Also no check that the swapParams/pools agree with the path. The unit-test MockCurveRouter uses the same 'last non-zero' rule (test/mocks/MockCurveRouter.sol), so the suite cannot detect the divergence.
localFindings.confidence: likely (Router NG semantics from the deployed Vyper source; confirm on fork)
localFindings.recommendation: Require the path to be contiguous: after the first zero pool slot, all remaining slots are zero, and the token immediately following the last non-zero pool equals sya.rewardToken().

localFindings.description: Exact-input swap with sqrtPriceLimitX96 = MAX_SQRT_PRICE - 1 can partially fill if in-range liquidity is exhausted; debt is computed from the actual delta.amount1, so the unswapped surplus (reward token) stays in the harvester after the tx. It is then credited to the NEXT caller's surplus. The current caller is protected only by minEthOut. Practically requires a near-empty pool (owner-chosen deepest pool), so impact is small.
localFindings.recommendation: Assert -delta.amount1() == surplus or pay any reward-token residue to msg.sender.

localFindings.description: Coverage check is keyed on the harvester's raw balanceOf, not on what SYA delivered. If a registered, non-exempt strategy token has no route (legitimately: strategy is new, empty, or its token is paused in SYA so nothing is delivered), any party can donate 1 wei of that token to the harvester and every harvest reverts RouteNotConfigured. Workaround exists: caller passes that strategy in exemptStrategies (SYA accepts any registered strategy), at the cost of not skimming it. Donation is permanent (no sweep).
localFindings.recommendation: Sell only the delta received during claim (snapshot balances before sya.claim), or skip tokens whose SYA tokenConfig is paused, or add an owner sweep.

localFindings.description: No sweep/rescue for ERC20, ERC1155 or ETH. ERC1155Holder accepts any ERC1155 from anyone; non-strategy ERC20s and ERC1155 ids other than the one a caller passes are permanently stuck. Stray strategy tokens, reward token and ETH are swept to the next harvest caller (a gift, not a loss).

Route ends and ethPool.currency1 are validated against sya.rewardToken() only at set time, while unlockCallback reads it live. If the SYA owner calls setRewardToken, every stored route and the ethPool become stale: routes output the old token (surplus underflow) or the V4 swap leaves an unsettled old-token delta (CurrencyNotSettled). Harvest bricks until the harvester owner re-registers all routes and the pool. Fail-loud, no fund loss; operational coupling between two owner roles worth documenting.
localFindings.recommendation: In harvest, check Currency.unwrap(ethPool.currency1) == sya.rewardToken() and revert with a named error; document the re-registration step in the SYA reward-token migration runbook.

sequence: 1. [opt] NFT: caller -> harvester (1 unit of nftIndex)
2. PM.take reward: PM -> harvester, owed = calc*1.01 (debt +owed)
3. sya.claim: NFT burned from harvester; strategies push yield tokens -> harvester; SYA pulls payment (<= owed by allowance) reward harvester -> SYA
4. each non-exempt strategy token with balance>0 (token != reward): harvester -> router, router -> harvester reward token
5. surplus = rewardBal - owed (underflow revert if sale < borrow); PM.swap exactIn surplus reward -> ETH delta
6. sync/transfer debt (owed + actual swap input)/settle; PM.take ETH -> harvester (receive gated to PM)
7. NFT refund: whole harvester balance of nftIndex -> caller
8. ethOut = address(this).balance; minEthOut + Unprofitable checks; ETH -> caller
invariantsClaimed: INV-1 Post-tx zero balances: harvester holds 0 ETH, 0 reward, 0 of each strategy token, 0 of nftIndex (breakable by LOCAL-002 residue, donations of non-strategy tokens/other NFT ids).
INV-2 PoolManager deltas net to zero inside unlock (enforced by V4; any mismatch reverts CurrencyNotSettled).
INV-3 Route coverage: a non-exempt strategy token with non-zero harvester balance and no route reverts the whole harvest (never strands).
INV-4 ethOut >= max(minEthOut, (gasMeasured + 60000) * tx.gasprice) or revert.
INV-5 No standing ERC20 allowances to sya/router after a call.
INV-6 Only harvest can trigger unlockCallback with the harvester as locker.
tokenFlow.rounding: Borrow rounds down (calc*10100/10000); over-borrow settled back. All value accrues to msg.sender; protocol (SYA) side fixed by SYA's own pricing.

trustAssumptions: PoolManager is canonical Uniswap V4; callback delivery to locker only.

SYA payment for the delivered yield never exceeds calculateClaimAmount * 1.01; otherwise claim's safeTransferFrom reverts (insufficient allowance) and the caller must exempt the offending strategy. Unit MockSYA makes estimate == delivered exactly, so this path is untested.
No SYA strategy skimSurplus and no Curve route step calls poolManager.unlock (nested-unlock hazard, fork-tested for live USDe strategy at block 26261000 only).

sya.rewardToken() is stable between setRoute/setEthPool and harvest (LOCAL-005).

Gas check protects the caller only; Unprofitable ignores the NFT's own value consumed by the claim.
Reward token is standard ERC20 (USDC); SafeERC20 + forceApprove cover USDT-shape.
